decision.reasoning_trace: Based on the product feed, the consideration set includes the SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, YMDK GH60 GK61 RGB Hot Swap Independent Driver Tyce-C ANSI Mechanical Keyboard DIY kit, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, Hyekit Custom Gaming Keyboard, and Bloody Gaming B740 Wired Optical Gaming Keyboard. The final choice is the SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini Mechanical Gaming Keyboard due to its high rating (4.5), positive reviews, and features such as adjustable actuation, compact 60% form factor, and RGB lighting.
